tools.name: create_watch_room
tools.description: Creates a private ScreenParty room where friends watch the same video in sync, in their browsers, with chat and voice. Use it when the user wants to watch something together now, or plan a watch party at a set time. Without start_time the room is ready now: the first person to open room_link becomes

tools.name: get_watch_party
tools.description: Looks up a watch party — a room made with create_watch_room, now or scheduled — by its 5-character code (from create_watch_room or from a ScreenParty link such as …/s/AB2CD or …room.html?room=AB2CD). Returns its title, start time, whether guests can enter yet and whether people are in it right now.

tools.name: update_watch_party
tools.description: Changes the start time and/or title of a watch party (a room made with create_watch_room, same room_code). The link stays the same, so invitations already sent keep working — prefer this over cancelling and creating a new one. Needs the organiser_key (or organiser_link) from create_watch_room. Guest

tools.name: cancel_watch_party
tools.description: Cancels a watch party (a room made with create_watch_room, same room_code): its countdown page and link stop working. tools.name: create_branded_link
tools.description: Creates a permanent public page (…/r/<slug>) with a name, an optional one-line description, colour and video. Everyone who opens it lands in that page's room, any time, so it suits teachers, classes, clubs and communities who reuse one link every week (for a one-off, use create_watch_room). Returns

tools.name: get_branded_link
tools.description: Shows what a branded page (…/r/<slug>) currently says: name, description, colour, video, whether it has a logo or background, and whether people are in its room right now. Use it before changing a page or to check a slug the user mentions. Read-only; needs no key.

tools.name: update_branded_link
tools.description: Changes the name, description, colour or video of a branded page made with create_branded_link. Pass only the fields to change; the link itself (slug) stays the same, so posters and shared links keep working. Needs the private edit_link (or slug and edit_key). tools.name: delete_branded_link
tools.description: Permanently deletes a branded page made with create_branded_link; its public link and posters stop working. Needs the private edit_link (or slug and edit_key). Cannot be undone; confirm with the user first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_watch_room, get_watch_party · Private data: create_watch_room, create_branded_link, update_branded_link, delete_branded_link · Public sink: create_watch_room, create_branded_link · Destructive: update_branded_link, delete_branded_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_watch_room, get_watch_party · Private data: create_watch_room, create_branded_link, update_branded_link, delete_branded_link · Public sink: create_watch_room, create_branded_link · Destructive: update_branded_link, delete_branded_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
